exposure: Absence of fetal heart rate cycling on the intrapartum CTG
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 684 cases of singleton pregnancies over 36 weeks gestation in cephalic presentation with recorded umbilical artery cord pH from a single center.
finding: The absence of fetal heart rate cycling on the intrapartum CTG was associated with intrapartum maternal pyrexia and lower Apgar scores (≤7 at 5 min), but not with fetal acidosis (umbilical cord arterial pH <7.05).
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery between cases with and without fetal heart rate cycling.
